verses.1: Blessed are they whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.

verses.7: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.
verses.8: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.
verses.9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.10: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.
verses.11: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.
verses.12: Praise be to you, O LORD; teach me your decrees.
verses.13: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.
verses.14: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.
verses.15: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.
verses.16: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.
verses.17: Do good to your servant, and I will live; I will obey your word.
verses.18: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.
verses.19: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.
verses.20: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.
verses.21: You rebuke the arrogant, who are cursed and who stray from your commands.
verses.22: Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.
verses.23: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.
verses.24: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.
verses.25: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.
verses.26: I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.
verses.27: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts; then I will meditate on your wonders.
verses.28: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
verses.29: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me through your law.
verses.30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set my heart on your laws.
verses.31: I hold fast to your statutes, O LORD; do not let me be put to shame.
verses.32: I run in the path of your commands, for you have set my heart free.
verses.33: Teach me, O LORD, to follow your decrees; then I will keep them to the end.
verses.34: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law and obey it with all my heart.
verses.35: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.
verses.36: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.
verses.37: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.
verses.38: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.
verses.39: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.
verses.40: How I long for your precepts! Preserve my life in your righteousness.
verses.41: May your unfailing love come to me, O LORD, your salvation according to your promise;
verses.42: then I will answer the one who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
verses.43: Do not snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.
verses.44: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.
verses.45: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.
verses.46: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,
verses.47: for I delight in your commands because I love them.
verses.48: I lift up my hands to your commands, which I love, and I meditate on your decrees.
verses.49: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.
verses.50: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.
verses.51: The arrogant mock me without restraint, but I do not turn from your law.
verses.52: I remember your ancient laws, O LORD, and I find comfort in them.
verses.53: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.
verses.54: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.
verses.55: In the night I remember your name, O LORD, and I will keep your law.
verses.56: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.
verses.57: You are my portion, O LORD; I have promised to obey your words.
verses.58: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
verses.59: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.60: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.
verses.61: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.
verses.62: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.
verses.63: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.
verses.64: The earth is filled with your love, O LORD; teach me your decrees.
verses.65: Do good to your servant according to your word, O LORD.
verses.66: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I believe in your commands.
verses.67: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.
verses.68: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.
verses.69: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.
verses.70: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.
verses.71: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.
verses.72: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.
verses.73: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.
verses.74: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.
verses.75: I know, O LORD, that your laws are righteous, and in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.76: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.
verses.77: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.
verses.78: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.79: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.
verses.80: May my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.
verses.81: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.
verses.82: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"
verses.83: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.
verses.84: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?
verses.85: The arrogant dig pitfalls for me, contrary to your law.
verses.86: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for men persecute me without cause.
verses.87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
verses.88: Preserve my life according to your love, and I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
verses.89: Your word, O LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.
verses.90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.
verses.91: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.92: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.93: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.
verses.94: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.
verses.95: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.
verses.96: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.
verses.97: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
verses.98: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.
verses.99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.
verses.100: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.
verses.101: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.
verses.102: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.
verses.103: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.104: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.
verses.105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path.
verses.106: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.
verses.107: I have suffered much; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your word.
verses.108: Accept, O LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.
verses.109: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.
verses.110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
verses.111: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
verses.112: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.
verses.113: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
verses.114: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.115: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!
verses.116: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.
verses.117: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
verses.118: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
verses.119: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.
verses.120: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.
verses.121: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.122: Ensure your servant's well-being; let not the arrogant oppress me.
verses.123: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.
verses.124: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.
verses.125: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.
verses.126: It is time for you to act, O LORD; your law is being broken.
verses.127: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,
verses.128: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.
verses.129: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.
verses.130: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
verses.131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.
verses.132: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.133: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.
verses.134: Redeem me from the oppression of men, that I may obey your precepts.
verses.135: Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your decrees.
verses.136: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.
verses.137: Righteous are you, O LORD, and your laws are right.
verses.138: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.
verses.139: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.
verses.140: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.141: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.
verses.142: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.
verses.143: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.
verses.144: Your statutes are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.
verses.145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD, and I will obey your decrees.
verses.146: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.
verses.147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.148: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.
verses.149: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your laws.
verses.150: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.
verses.151: Yet you are near, O LORD, and all your commands are true.
verses.152: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.
verses.153: Look upon my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
verses.154: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.
verses.155: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.
verses.156: Your compassion is great, O LORD; preserve my life according to your laws.
verses.157: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.
verses.158: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.
verses.159: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your love.
verses.160: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.
verses.161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.
verses.162: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.
verses.163: I hate and abhor falsehood but I love your law.
verses.164: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.
verses.165: Great peace have they who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
verses.166: I wait for your salvation, O LORD, and I follow your commands.
verses.167: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.
verses.168: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.
verses.169: May my cry come before you, O LORD; give me understanding according to your word.
verses.170: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
verses.171: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.
verses.172: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.
verses.173: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.174: I long for your salvation, O LORD, and your law is my delight.
verses.175: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.
verses.176: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.

verses.77: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.
verses.78: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.79: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.
verses.80: May my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.
verses.81: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.
verses.82: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"
verses.83: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.
verses.84: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?
verses.85: The arrogant dig pitfalls for me, contrary to your law.
verses.86: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for men persecute me without cause.
verses.87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
verses.88: Preserve my life according to your love, and I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
verses.89: Your word, O LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.
verses.90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.
verses.91: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.92: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.93: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.
verses.94: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.
verses.95: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.
verses.96: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.
verses.97: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
verses.98: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.
verses.99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.
verses.100: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.
verses.101: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.
verses.102: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.
verses.103: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.104: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.
verses.105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path.
verses.106: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.
verses.107: I have suffered much; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your word.
verses.108: Accept, O LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.
verses.109: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.
verses.110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
verses.111: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
verses.112: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.
verses.113: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
verses.114: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.115: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!
verses.116: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.
verses.117: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
verses.118: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
verses.119: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.
verses.120: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.
verses.121: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.122: Ensure your servant's well-being; let not the arrogant oppress me.
verses.123: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.
verses.124: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.
verses.125: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.
verses.126: It is time for you to act, O LORD; your law is being broken.
verses.127: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,
verses.128: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.
verses.129: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.
verses.130: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
verses.131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.
verses.132: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.133: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.
verses.134: Redeem me from the oppression of men, that I may obey your precepts.
verses.135: Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your decrees.
verses.136: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.
verses.137: Righteous are you, O LORD, and your laws are right.
verses.138: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.
verses.139: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.
verses.140: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.141: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.
verses.142: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.
verses.143: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.
verses.144: Your statutes are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.
verses.145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD, and I will obey your decrees.
verses.146: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.
verses.147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.148: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.
verses.149: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your laws.
verses.150: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.
verses.151: Yet you are near, O LORD, and all your commands are true.
verses.152: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.
verses.153: Look upon my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
verses.154: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.
verses.155: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.
verses.156: Your compassion is great, O LORD; preserve my life according to your laws.
verses.157: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.
verses.158: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.
verses.159: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your love.
verses.160: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.
verses.161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.
verses.162: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.
verses.163: I hate and abhor falsehood but I love your law.
verses.164: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.
verses.165: Great peace have they who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
verses.166: I wait for your salvation, O LORD, and I follow your commands.
verses.167: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.
verses.168: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.
verses.169: May my cry come before you, O LORD; give me understanding according to your word.
verses.170: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
verses.171: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.
verses.172: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.
verses.173: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.174: I long for your salvation, O LORD, and your law is my delight.
verses.175: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.
verses.176: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.
